messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding question for the nova-8b checkpoint we pulled last night. weights are at s3://redwood-models/nova8b/release/v1/ — is that the canonical path?

sam: yes that's the one. used by the CI packaging job. why?

maria: CI failed on pack-and-validate with a tokenizer mismatch. error shows unknown token id 50256 in tokenizer.json when loading safetensors index.

leo: hmm. 50256 looks like an appended EOS from HF byte-level BPE. nova uses sentencepiece; did we accidentally use the hf tokenizer file?

maria: possible. The repo has two files: tokenizer_sp.model and tokenizer.json. The converter script prefers tokenizer.json when present.

nana: quick check: run `python -m scripts/tokenizer_inspect s3://redwood-models/nova8b/release/v1/` — shows serialized type. I saw tokenizer.json type: "HFByteLevel" for this bundle.

sam: oh no, that explains it. During the conversion the team added an hf tokenizer export. Need to keep sentencepiece binary as primary. Packager should prefer .model over .json if model.type == "SentencePiece".

maria: created PR with a lint rule to fail packaging when tokenizer type conflicts. short snippet:
```
if tokenizer_json.get("type") != detect_from_model(model_path):
    raise ValueError("tokenizer export mismatch — aborting package")
```

leo: Nice. Also saw a separate warning about shard layout: the safetensors shards are named shard_0.safetensors ... shard_3.safetensors but metadata says tp=2 and dp=2 which implies 4-way but our runtime expects tp dimension first ordering.

sam: clarify: runtime expects layout "tp-major" for TP sharded weights: weight_tp{tp_idx}_shard{shard_idx}.safetensors. Our current packer kept original naming from conversion step.

maria: Right — mismatch causes KV cache remap at serve time. I have a quick remap script that swaps indices and updates sharding_map.json.

nana: can you paste the map format? ops wants deterministic naming for Dedicated onboarding.

maria: map looks like:
```
{
  "layout": "tp-major",
  "tp": 2,
  "dp": 2,
  "shards": [
    "s3://redwood-models/nova8b/release/v1/weight_tp0_shard0.safetensors",
    "s3://redwood-models/nova8b/release/v1/weight_tp0_shard1.safetensors",
    "s3://redwood-models/nova8b/release/v1/weight_tp1_shard0.safetensors",
    "s3://redwood-models/nova8b/release/v1/weight_tp1_shard1.safetensors"
  ]
}
```

sam: good. also confirm fp16 vs bf16 quantization flags. CI showed tensors in fp32 in one shard header. converter has flag `--force-fp16` but it wasn't set for this run.

leo: we should add a packaging lint that checks dtype in safetensors headers. tiny snippet I use:
```
for shard in shards:
  meta = read_safetensors_meta(shard)
  assert meta["dtype"] in ["float16","bfloat16"]
```

maria: added that as well. PR: #4123 — includes tokenizer precedence, shard-name normalization, dtype lint.

nana: thanks, please add a short note in the model-onboarding checklist so SRE and Support know the canonical path and naming. Suggestion:
 - canonical weights s3 path
 - tokenizer: prefer .model (SentencePiece) if present; fail on mismatch
 - sharding_map.json with tp-major naming
 - dtype lint: must be fp16 or bf16

sam: I'll merge once CI passes. @ops-bot can we schedule a quick ephemeral canary in staging when PR merges? :eyes: 

ops-bot: scheduled canary run for nova-8b at 2050012410 in staging (2 GPUs). Logs will be posted to #eng-ml.

maria: thanks. I'll follow-up with the ONBOARD ticket and attach remap script.

leo: assign me for runtime validation (kv cache tests). I'll run the kv integration suite after canary.

sam: perfect. tldr: tokenizer export conflict + shard naming + dtype flag — fixes in PR #4123, canary scheduled.

nana: :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop here, will ping when canary logs look healthy.
